borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
decision_conditions: <div><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">The single storey front and side wraparound extension&nbsp;would appear&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14.6667px;">overly prominent and dominate the front of the modest end-of-terrace dwelling,</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">&nbsp;which would unbalance</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">&nbsp;the symmetry and uniformity of the terrace row, thus impacting the character and appearance of the area, notably given the location of the application site within the Becontree Estate.&nbsp;</span>As such, the proposed development is contrary to:</div><div><br style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);"></div><p><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">- National Planning Policy Framework National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, December 2024)</span></p><p><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">- Policies D1, D4, D5, D6 and HC1 of the London Plan (March 2021)</span></p><p><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">- Policies DMD1, DMD4, DMD6,&nbsp;</span><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">SP2 and SPP6</span><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">&nbsp;of The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)</span></p><p><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012)</span></p>

<p><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">The proposed rear and side infill extension, by reason of its excessive depth and siting, would constitute unacceptable levels of&nbsp;</span><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">overbearing,&nbsp;</span><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">overshadowing and loss of daylight impacts to the neighbouring property no.24 Bainbridge Road.&nbsp;</span><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">The proposed development therefore constitutes unneighbourly development and is contrary to: </span></p><p><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">- National Planning Policy Framework National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, December 2024)</span></p><p><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">- Policy D4 of the London Plan (March 2021);</span></p><p><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">- Policies DMD1, DMD5 and</span><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">&nbsp;</span><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">SP2</span><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">&nbsp;of The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037: (September 2024)</span></p><p><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012);</span></p>
description: Part retrospective application for the construction of a single storey side extension and proposed construction of a single storey rear and side infill extension and a single storey front and side extension
